metadata.description: Query the Armis Knowledge base — organizational standards, CWE remediation, framework and technology guidance — directly from your coding agent. Ships dev and stage variants so they can be installed side-by-side.

plugins.name: armis-knowledge-dev
plugins.description: DEV environment (knowledge-mcp.moose-dev.armis.com). Adds /knowledge-dev, /cwe-fix-dev, /framework-guidance-dev, and /tech-guidance-dev commands. Reads ARMIS_CLIENT_ID, ARMIS_CLIENT_SECRET, and ARMIS_TENANT_SLUG; exchanges them for a short-lived JWT on startup. Tenant isolation enforced server-side; no knowledge data stored on disk.

plugins.name: armis-knowledge-stage
plugins.description: STAGE environment (knowledge-mcp.moose-stg.armis.com). Adds /knowledge-stage, /cwe-fix-stage, /framework-guidance-stage, and /tech-guidance-stage commands. Reads ARMIS_CLIENT_ID, ARMIS_CLIENT_SECRET, and ARMIS_TENANT_SLUG; exchanges them for a short-lived JWT on startup. Tenant isolation enforced server-side; no knowledge data stored on disk.
